summary: litespeed-cache npm package beacons installer identity to webhook.site on install and require
details: This npm package (a name resemblance to the WordPress LiteSpeed Cache plugin, which is not an npm module) ships a preinstall script and a top-level index.js that both collect os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and issue an HTTPS request to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (https://webhook.site/c72c8172-a424-4a19-91b4-28f40cae3c83). The beacon fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook, and is repeated at module load so that any consumer that require()s or imports the package also transmits host identifiers, bypassing `--ignore-scripts`. webhook.site is an anonymous third-party request-inspection collector; there is no functional package behavior beyond the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
